name: Symphonic Noise
description: A generative wall of orchestral-style sound for study or art. Slow-shifting chords, layered voices, never loops.

name: Drum Machine
description: A 16-step drum sequencer with five synthesized voices and a drive/fold/crush distortion chain.

name: DSS1
description: A full digital sound studio in one page — step-sequenced drums, a filter-swept bass synth, an ambient pad, a Euclidean rhythm generator, and more, with built-in reverb/delay.

name: BitCrusher Worklet Demo
description: A bit-depth and sample-rate-reduction bitcrusher built as a real AudioWorklet, demoed live on a sine tone.

name: HNW9
description: A nine-pad harsh noise wall instrument — drag each black-and-white pad to sculpt noise thickness, filter, drive, oscillators, bitcrush, feedback, and motion.

name: Factorial Melody Generator
description: Turns the digits of n! into an evolving melody — tap to play/pause, swipe to change n, double-tap to switch modes.

name: The Sound of Functions
description: Generates random mathematical functions, draws each as an animated glowing graph, and turns it into sound.

name: Oscillate — Scroll Bars
description: Turns your microphone input into a scrolling neon bar-graph waveform that streams by and slowly fades.

name: Checkerboard Swirl
description: A 16×16 checkerboard that bursts into color and swirls when you tap, swipe, or press — then gently settles back to crisp black and white.

name: Heavy Spin Morph
description: A wireframe icosphere you can spin and fling, slowly morphing between cube, sphere, and octahedron. Double-tap to jump shapes.

name: Maisie's Magic Draw
description: A sparkly finger-painting app — glowing ink trails, draggable emoji stickers, a magic wand burst, and a save/share button.

name: Smooth Wave Field
description: A no-UI generative wave field — tap and drag to ripple through shifting triangle, circle, square, or pixel grids. Two-finger tap changes the renderer, pinch to rescale.

name: One-Thumb Racer
description: Drive with just your thumb. Drag anywhere in the pad to steer, long-press for nitro.

name: Tilt Pipe Quest
description: Tilt your device to guide balls through neon pipes into the goal zone. Five handcrafted levels, touch-joystick fallback included.

name: Threes Minimal
description: A minimalist sliding-tile merge puzzle — combine matching tiles and chase a new high score.

name: Maisie Eats Everything 2
description: Grow a hungry rainbow unicorn by eating everything smaller than you across ten whimsical levels.

name: Ballz Game
description: A physics ball-breaker: aim with the slider, launch a volley of balls at descending numbered bricks, and grab the gold dot to add another ball.

name: Peggle Minimal Forge
description: A minimal Peggle-style peg board — drop balls to bounce, spark, and ricochet through a grid of pegs.

name: Star Bucket
description: Catch falling stars for points and dodge the squares in a fast arcade bucket-catcher.

name: Ricochet 8-Bit
description: A pixel-art Peggle/Breakout hybrid — launch a volley of balls to ricochet off descending blocks, chain combos, and grab power-ups like fireball, split, and rewind.

name: Ricochet 8-Bit: Sequence 11
description: An expanded build of Ricochet 8-Bit with giant balls, homing shots, laser-blaster blocks, multi-cell L/T/giant shapes, and a one-time second-chance save.

name: Spinner Drop
description: Tap to drop balls through spinning obstacles into a moving bucket — 10 shots per round, physics-driven bounces.

name: Maisie's Kitty Cat Adventure
description: Drag a hungry kitty around a neon city, gobbling treats and growing from Tiny to WORLD size.
